zh.title: 民航局舉辦無人機與先進空中交通論壇 聚焦國際航空安全規範
zh.summary: 民航局11月23日舉辦無人機與先進空中交通論壇，邀國外專家分享。
body: 交通部民用航空局舉辦「2026國際無人機及先進空中交通論壇」，11月23日登場。論壇邀請國外民航主管機關與專家分享實務經驗。
論壇聚焦國際無人機與先進空中交通（AAM）發展，以及國際航空安全規範。民航局表示，希望透過專家分享，促進臺灣無人機產業及制度與國際接軌。
民航局指出，先進空中交通若要從技術研發走向實際營運，仍需建立適航認證、安全監理及空域整合機制。電動垂直起降航空器（eVTOL）等新興技術，未來有機會拓展都市與區域運輸、緊急救援及偏遠地區交通服務。

en.title: Taiwan CAA holds drone and advanced air mobility forum, with safety rules on agenda
en.summary: Taiwan's CAA held a drone and advanced air mobility forum on November 23, inviting foreign experts.
body: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) held an international forum on drones and advanced air mobility on November 23. The agency invited foreign aviation regulators and experts to share practical experience.

The forum focused on international developments in drones and advanced air mobility (AAM), as well as international aviation safety rules. The CAA said expert exchanges were intended to help Taiwan's drone industry and institutional framework connect with international practice.

The CAA said moving AAM from research and development into actual operations still requires mechanisms for airworthiness certification, safety oversight and airspace integration. It said emerging technologies such as electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft could eventually expand urban and regional transport, emergency rescue and transport services in remote areas.
